title: Ciao Bella Cottage | Rosemary Beach Cottage Vacation Rental | Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Our Ciao Bella Rosemary Beach cottage vacation rental is sure to make you swoon! Click here to learn more about this 3-bed, 3-bath charmer.
description_expanded:
Property includes private beach access at Sunset Beach, and pool access at the gulf front pool. Beach service chairs can be rented through La Dolce Vita. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Welcome to Ciao Bella! Located in Seacrest Beach on the gulf side of 30A.

With three bedrooms, three baths, and a large open design, Ciao Bella is perfect for up to eight guests who want to relax in casual luxury. The first thing you notice when you walk in is the light coastal feel of the décor. The comfortable living area flows into the kitchen and dining room, providing a space for easy conversation.

Enjoy cooking in the kitchen which is equipped with stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and lots of light. Serve at the table in the dining room right off the kitchen or at the breakfast bar. You can also head out to the patio with your plates and enjoy the warm, welcoming Florida air. Feel like a cookout? Just use our barbecue grill!

The master bedroom and bathroom are on the first floor, with en suite bathroom and flat-screen TV. The remaining two bedrooms are on the second floor, each with its own private bathroom. The first upstairs bedroom has a set of bunk beds, perfect for families traveling with children. The other has access to a private balcony, where you can view the gorgeous Florida landscape.

Want to head out and see the sights? Grab one of the four complimentary adult bikes and head out. Tour the quaint town center, try some of the local restaurants and cafes, go shopping, or just ride and enjoy the sights. If you want to hit the beach, it's a short ride away.

Ciao Bella Cottage has the spaciousness and amenities that make a good vacation plan a great one. Book it today and find out why we call it Ciao Bella.

This property requires a 7 night minimum stay, Saturday to Saturday during spring break and summer and a 2 night minimum stay during shoulder season.

*No access to Rosemary Beach walkovers or pools
